Remark
[Nonzero boundary conditions] ↗ def:weak-solution-elliptic-bvp ↗ def:trace-operator 1. ch6:6.1-rem-4\group Weak Solutions

Assume $\partial U$ is $C^1$ and $u\in H^1(U)$ solves \[ \begin{cases} Lu = f & \text{in } U \\ u = g & \text{on } \partial U. \end{cases} \] If $g$ is the trace of $w\in H^1(U)$, then $\tilde u:=u-w\in H_0^1(U)$ solves \[ \begin{cases} L\tilde u = \tilde f & \text{in } U \\ \tilde u = 0 & \text{on } \partial U, \end{cases} \] where $\tilde f := f - Lw \in H^{-1}(U)$.
